DDS_SOFT_AI.initial_phase: A2 centre at evaluation 1; A2-region samples through evaluation 16

paired_comparison.effect_rule: A method is useful only when SOFT_AI wins at least one paired threshold for at least one seed and its arm maximum best NSE is no more than 0.02 below the A3 GLOBAL arm maximum. STRONG requires all three methods; one or two useful methods are PARTIAL; zero is NONE.

region.region_definition: median of Transformer qobs (5 seeds plus ensemble median), Ridge qobs, A1 Top1 synthetic inverse predictions on the best 20 fixed test cases, and A1 historical best-broad candidates; interval is widened by robust source quantiles and normalized padding.
